summary: Verified responsive top nav fix. Logged in as admin with MFA, tested desktop widths 1920/1536/1366/1280 and mobile 390. No horizontal overflow at any width (scrollWidth == innerWidth). account-menu visible on the right at every width. nav-more button present at all tested desktop widths; opens a dropdown with the expected overflow items (nav-more-media, nav-more-vmix-help, nav-more-users). Clicking nav-more-media navigates to /media. Direct nav item nav-scenes navigates to /scenes. Mobile nav at 390x844 unaffected and no overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: Even at 1920px the nav-more button is still rendered (contains media, vmix-help, users). The request stated 'at a very wide width (1920) all items may fit and nav-more may be absent' — current behaviour keeps nav-more at 1920. This is acceptable per the spec ('that is acceptable as long as there is no overflow') but could be tuned if the design intent is for all items to show at ultra-wide.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Responsive nav regression tested at 1920/1536/1366/1280/390. All pass. Overflow dropdown testids verified: nav-more, nav-more-media, nav-more-vmix-help, nav-more-users.
